findings.issue: את marks אלה as object and תאכלו is qal imperfect 2mp (the addressees eat). «Estos … comerán» makes that demonstrative the third-party subject who eats.
Common noun הארבה (H697) is left as an untranslated lemma.
Common noun הסלעם (H5556) is left as an untranslated lemma.
Common noun החרגל (H2728) is left as an untranslated lemma.
Common noun החגב (H2284) is left as an untranslated lemma.
מֵהֶם only licenses from/of plus 3mp; «desde» narrows it to a point of origin.

notes: Four למינו/למינהו phrases and the three וְ conjunctions are kept; bare את is unlexicalized.
